runners.name: Grittiness
runners.comment: GRITTINESS four then three wide in pursuit, advanced to stack outside the top pair midway on the turn, came under coaxing near the five-sixteenths pole, swung three to four wide into upper stretch, took over narrow command with three-sixteenths to go, dug in under threat to the outside and gamely fended off the runner up to score on the wire.

runners.name: Old Time Rocknroll
runners.comment: OLD TIME ROCKNROLL coaxed from the gate, chased along the inside, suddenly leapt over a shadow near the seven furlong marker, then hopped a second one before being guided outside four paths off the rail down the backstretch, losing about two to three lengths of ground altogether, tucked three wide through the turn and came under coaxing with five-sixteenths to go, angled five wide into upper stretch and was leaned on by IZE A RUNNER to the inside, rallied with good courage to be heads apart for command a furlong out, dug in fighting on to the finish but was ultimately denied on the line.

runners.name: Ize a Runner
runners.comment: IZE A RUNNER coaxed from the start, chased just off the inside coaxed along from three furlongs out, angled four wide into upper stretch and leaned on the aforementioned foe briefly straightened away, ran on to secure the show honors.

runners.name: Mr. Miracle
runners.comment: MR. MIRACLE bobbled at the break, dueled in hand five paths off the inside down the backstretch, tucked to the two path through the turn coming under urging with five-sixteenths to go, continued in the two path into upper stretch, got displaced from the front with three-sixteenths to run and weakened in the late stages.

runners.name: Relative Risk
runners.comment: RELATIVE RISK dueled in hand inside of MR MIRACLE three paths off the inside down the backstretch and then along the rail through the turn, came under encouragement with five-sixteenths remaining, took the inside route into upper stretch and weakened.

runners.name: Go Dharma
runners.comment: GO DHARMA took the overland route in pursuit six paths off the rail down the backstretch and then four wide through the turn under prolonged motivation from the nine-sixteenths pole, cornered four to five wide into upper stretch in retreat and faltered in the drive.

runners.name: Onepac
runners.comment: ONEPAC went to the front on the outside, moved clear while dropping from the four path to the two path early on the turn, was challenged outside the three-eighths pole, moved to the rail late on the bend, responded well when asked for his best in upper stretch, came under a right-handed crop outside the furlong marker, switched to a left-handed crop while disposing of the runner-up outside the sixteenth-pole then was placed under a hand-ride late.

runners.name: Chili Palmer
runners.comment: CHILI PALMER brushed with THATBOYAIN'TRIGHT at the start, showed speed between horses, jostled with the aforementioned rival late on the backstretch, chased in the two then three path on the turn, made a bid outside the three-eighths pole, battled outside the winner under a drive into the final furlong, was turned away near the sixteenth-pole and outfinished while clear for the place.

runners.name: Fightforallegiance
runners.comment: FIGHTFORALLEGIANCE showed speed between horses, was taken up in tight quarters near the five-eighths pole, started the turn in the four path while drafting behind horses, dropped in while pausing off heels outside the half-mile pole, continued in the two path through the turn, was asked coming to the quarter-pole then came under a drive in upper stretch, chased into the final furlong and weakened but held the show.

runners.name: Asked and Answered
runners.comment: ASKED AND ANSWERED broke out at the start, settled on the outside, gained in the five then four path on the turn, made a bid with three furlongs to run, chased outside into the final furlong and tired.

runners.name: Bourbon Hangover
runners.comment: BOURBON HANGOVER dropped back while urged along, moved in late on the backstretch, shifted from the two path to the four path late on the turn, came out to the seven path in upper stretch and failed to threaten.

runners.name: Varenna
runners.comment: VARENNA showed speed between horses, dropped back near the half-mile pole, went around the turn in the three to four path and retreated.

runners.name: Thatboyain'tright
runners.comment: THATBOYAIN'TRIGHT brushed with CHILI PALMER at the start then was hustled, showed speed inside of five opponents, jostled with CHILI PALMER late on the backstretch, dropped back while inside on the turn and faltered then was eased but walked off.

runners.name: Amie's Symphony
runners.comment: AMIE'S SYMPHONY settled tracking the front just off the inside from just off the pace, tipped three wide inside three furlongs to go, angled four wide into upper stretch let out for the drive, rallied to take narrow command a furlong out, dug in head to head to the finish fighting gamely to get the nod on the wire.

runners.name: Don't Jinx It
runners.comment: DON'T JINX IT established the front and showed the way in hand along the inside though sensible splits, remained patiently handled until roused taking the inside route into upper stretch, dug in under threat and was collared a furlong out, battled on gamely inside the top one head to head to the finish and was ultimately denied by a bob on the line.

runners.name: Carmensita (ARG)
runners.comment: CARMENSITA (ARG) tracked the pace along the inside coming under a ride with five-sixteenths to go, angled three to four wide at the head of the stretch, offered up a mild bid.

runners.name: Fleetingly
runners.comment: FLEETINGLY got away to a slow start breaking last without incident, saved ground at the tail of the field through the first turn before taking to the two path down the backstretch, went just off the inside into the far turn before tipping out three then four wide and coming under encouragement three furlongs out, tipped four to five wide at the top of the lane, offered up a mild kick.

runners.name: Lady Firefoot
runners.comment: LADY FIREFOOT tracked the pace along the inside patiently handled until set down spinning from the two path into upper stretch, dug in under a drive running on through to the end but was outfinished in the final jumps to the wire.

runners.name: National Archive
runners.comment: NATIONAL ARCHIVE settled tracking the leader in closest aim from the two path, came under urging with seven-sixteenths to go, spun three wide into upper stretch, dug in under a drive, had the rider lose the handle on his crop from his right hand just outside the sixteenth pole, kept on to the finish but got outkicked.

runners.name: Gracie's Delight
runners.comment: GRACIE'S DELIGHT broke alertly and went straight to the front, dictated terms while inside on the turn, powered away under a hand-ride in upper stretch and drew off under strong hand-urging to prove much the best.

runners.name: Bellacose
runners.comment: BELLACOSE broke in and bumped with BACKSTREETS, tracked the pace on the outside, was given her cue in the two path on the turn, chased the winner into upper stretch and proved no match while just able to hold the place.

runners.name: That'sthefactjack
runners.comment: THAT'STHEFACTJACK was hustled from the gate, dropped back under urging, raced inside to the two path on the turn, swung out into upper stretch, reached about the seven path inside the three-sixteenths pole and improved to just miss the place while clear for the show.

runners.name: Credit Risk
runners.comment: CREDIT RISK settled on the outside under some urging, was roused in the four path on the turn and failed to respond.

runners.name: Backstreets
runners.comment: BACKSTREETS bobbled slightly at the start then was bumped, established a good position just off the pace, moved in with five furlongs to run, saved ground while asked on the turn and came up empty.

runners.name: Circuit Court
runners.comment: CIRCUIT COURT dropped back to the rear of the field, went around the turn in the three path and also failed to respond.

runners.name: Doves and Hawks
runners.comment: DOVES AND HAWKS settled four paths off the inside down the backstretch near the rear of the field, tucked three wide into the far turn and steadily advanced to mid pack, tipped back out four wide at the five-sixteenths before coming under coaxing near the quarter pole, angled six wide into upper stretch set down for the drive, rallied to take narrow command nearing the eighth pole, edged away under a drive to prevail.

runners.name: Delta Sun
runners.comment: DELTA SUN hesitated at the start standing as the latch was sprung and got away last conceding five to six lengths to the front before settling into stride, chased two to three paths off the rail down the backstretch near the rear of the field, went just off the inside through the far turn coming under encouragement with five-sixteenths to go, angled out eight wide into upper stretch, rallied belatedly with good courage to secure the place honors at the end.

runners.name: Peaceably
runners.comment: PEACEABLY buckled at the break but broke near the top despite it, chased three then two wide in aim of the front coming under urging three furlongs from home, angled four to five wide into upper stretch, dug in under a drive seizing narrow and brief command inside the three-sixteenths marker before being overtaken by the eventual winner, ran on through to the finish.

runners.name: Lady Girvin
runners.comment: LADY GIRVIN saved ground near the rear of the field, tipped to the two path placed to encouragement three furlongs out, angled four wide into upper stretch and kept on to the wire.

runners.name: C'Mon Over Valerie
runners.comment: C'MON OVER VALERIE chased four then three wide from mid pack coming under urging at the three-eighths pole, angled five wide into upper stretch, briefly paused straightened away, lost position through to the eighth pole, then improved position through to the finish while staying on one paced.

runners.name: Shook Up the World
runners.comment: SHOOK UP THE WORLD chased just off the inside and then along the inside coming under a ride near the quarter pole, spun two to three wide into upper stretch, weakened in the late stages.

runners.name: Adaptor
runners.comment: ADAPTOR raced three then two wide in aim of the front coming under motivation near the quarter pole, cornered three wide at the top of the stretch, weakened through to the finish.

runners.name: Amphibious
runners.comment: AMPHIBIOUS three then two wide in pursuit from mid pack, came under encouragement with five-sixteenths remaining, went just off the inside into upper stretch, weakened.

runners.name: Mariska
runners.comment: MARISKA showed the way in hand along the inside until placed to urging three furlongs out, took the inside route into upper stretch, yielded the front just inside three-sixteenths to go and tired.

runners.name: D'oro's Girl
runners.comment: D'ORO'S GIRL chased just off the inside and then along the inside from near the rear of the field, came under coaxing with seven-sixteenths to run, went two to three wide at the head of the stretch, made no impact.

runners.name: As Pretty She Is
runners.comment: AS PRETTY SHE IS went to the front then showed the way with a clear advantage, controlled the action while inside on the turn, drew off coming to the quarter-pole, came off the inside into upper stretch then responded well when set down, extended the advantage into the final furlong and proved much the best under steady urging.

runners.name: Gnosis
runners.comment: GNOSIS chased the pace, went around the turn in the three path, came into upper stretch in the five path and narrowly earned the place while no match for the winner.

runners.name: Risky Mission
runners.comment: RISKY MISSION was urged along on the outside, went around most of the turn in the five path then dropped to the four path, pursued the winner into upper stretch and also proved no match then missed the place but earned the show.

runners.name: Dry Drastic
runners.comment: DRY DRASTIC was hustled from the gate then urged along off the pace, saved ground on the turn, moved to the two path late on the bend, chased into upper stretch and weakened.

runners.name: Flying Solo
runners.comment: FLYING SOLO was urged along towards the rear, dropped from the three path to the two path early on the turn, continued in the two path into the stretch and lacked the needed response.

runners.name: Cara's Chrome
runners.comment: CARA'S CHROME dropped back to the rear then angled in around the five-eighths pole, moved from the inside to the three path midway through the turn and failed to threaten.

runners.name: Two Ay Jeez
runners.comment: TWO AY JEEZ was hustled from the gate then urged along off the pace, dropped in to save ground on the turn and came up empty.

runners.name: Sophia's Magic
runners.comment: SOPHIA'S MAGIC broke a step slow, was ridden along off the pace, raced inside to the two path on the turn, was driven into the stretch in the three path then moved further out and was no factor.

runners.name: Warrior's Blessing
runners.comment: WARRIOR'S BLESSING was urged along on the inside of JOSIE'S WATCHING, dropped from the five path to the four path early on the turn, moved out in upper stretch and also was no factor.

runners.name: Jackpot Judy
runners.comment: JACKPOT JUDY was hustled from the gate then chased the pace on the outside, dropped back in the four path on the turn, came into the stretch in the five path and faltered.

runners.name: Josie's Watching
runners.comment: JOSIE'S WATCHING was ridden along on the far outside, dropped back in the six then five path on the turn and also faltered.

runners.name: Silsbee
runners.comment: SILSBEE chased along the inside patiently handled until set down spinning just off the inside into upper stretch, rallied splitting foes at the three-sixteenths marker before taking command a furlong out, inched away to the finish kept to task.

runners.name: Charlibu
runners.comment: CHARLIBU chased four paths off the inside down the backstretch before tucking to the two path through the turn coming under encouragement with five-sixteenths remaining, angled six wide into upper stretch, ran on to secure the place honors in the final jumps.

runners.name: Aporia
runners.comment: APORIA chased four then three wide coming under a ride near the quarter pole, angled five wide into upper stretch, seized command at the three-sixteenths, dug in under threat and was nosed at the eighth pole by the top one, ran on through to the finish and was caught for the place honors in the final strides while just preserving the show.

runners.name: Bella Knows
runners.comment: BELLA KNOWS struck the near side stall at the start and then bumped VIABLE ASSET, chased just off the inside and then along the inside under urging from the five-sixteenths pole, spun two to three wide for home, kicked on belatedly and just missed for the show honors on the wire.

runners.name: Mezcal Mama
runners.comment: MEZCAL MAMA chased just off the inside from the tail of the field coming under encouragement with five-sixteenths to go, went eight wide into upper stretch and improved position to the finish, then got pulled up after the gallop out and was attended to and vetted and subsequently transported off the course via the equine ambulance.

runners.name: Mid Summer
runners.comment: MID SUMMER struck the off side stall at the start, chased just off the inside and then along the inside under urging from the five-sixteenths pole, went seven wide into upper stretch and passed tired rivals to the end.

runners.name: Only for Now
runners.comment: ONLY FOR NOW chased three then two wide patiently handled until set down angled four wide into upper stretch, weakened in the late stages.

runners.name: Viable Asset
runners.comment: VIABLE ASSET got bumped at the start by BELLA KNOWS, pressed the pace four then three wide outside of the leader, came under encouragement at the five-sixteenths marker, swung four wide into upper stretch, drifted in at the three-sixteenths forcing ORI to steady off her heels when APORIA went on by to her outside, then tired through to the finish.

runners.name: Ori
runners.comment: ORI chased three then two wide coming under a ride near the quarter pole, spun three wide into upper stretch, got forced to steady off the heels of VIABLE ASSET at the three-sixteenths when beginning to back away, then tired through to the end.

runners.name: Celtic Dawn
runners.comment: CELTIC DAWN showed the way in hand just off the inside and then along the inside through swift splits under pressure from VIABLE ASSET, came under coaxing near the quarter pole and took the inside route into upper stretch, yielded the front with three-sixteenths to go and tired.

runners.name: Rugby
runners.comment: RUGBY angled in before the first turn, settled in the four then three path, was asked with a half-mile to run, swung out to the six path into the stretch then rallied on the outside, closed strongly to get the lead outside the sixteenth-pole then went clear late under good handling.

runners.name: Nystateofmind
runners.comment: NYSTATEOFMIND was hustled from the gate, saved ground while rated just off the pace, moved to the two path around the five-sixteenths pole, came into the stretch in the four path, gained to make a bid approaching the furlong marker, battled with two foes while bumping with BECKETT into the final sixteenth and was outfinished while able to get the place.

runners.name: Papa Brez
runners.comment: PAPA BREZ angled in at the rear, rounded the first turn in the two path, settled at the back, went around the far turn in the four path, turned into the stretch in the seven path and finished with late energy to just get the show.

runners.name: Beckett
runners.comment: BECKETT was hustled from the gate, moved from the four path to the three path on the first turn, prompted the pace on the outside, vied in the two path on the far turn, spun into the stretch in the three path, took the lead inside the quarter-pole, led under a drive into the final furlong, was bumped by UNSPOKEN while being headed near the sixteenth-pole and weakened late.

runners.name: Bet On Zion
runners.comment: BET ON ZION settled while inside to the two path, steadied while blocked at the three-sixteenths pole, came under light urging shortly thereafter, steadied again at the furlong marker and lacked the needed kick.

runners.name: Malachi Miracle
runners.comment: MALACHI MIRACLE was reserved while inside to the two path, steadied while going for the same hole as BET ON ZION at the three-sixteenths pole, chased into the final furlong and also lacked the needed kick.

runners.name: Maddenbleu
runners.comment: MADDENBLEU went around the turns in the two to three path and lacked the needed response.

runners.name: Unspoken
runners.comment: UNSPOKEN moved in while hustled to the front, raced in the two path on the first turn, showed the way in hand, vied inside on the far turn, lost the advantage in upper stretch and gave way.

runners.name: Bougie Bro
runners.comment: BOUGIE BRO was pinched back between horses at the start, went around the turns in the three to four path and failed to rally.

runners.name: Max Cap
runners.comment: MAX CAP dropped from the five path to the four path on the first turn, tracked outside without cover, chased in the three path on the far turn, spun into the stretch in the five path, dropped back into the final furlong and tired.
